text:
sam_sales: Acme compliance sent a tightened checklist. Asks: SIG/CAIQ snapshot, DPA with SCC references, evidence of EU-only processing, timeline for DSAR deletions (they want <30 days), and a sandbox for compliance testing.

jordan_sec: quick clarifying q: when they say EU-only processing, do they mean no egress at all or acceptable if keys never leave EU? Also, do they require that logs (for billing/audit) stay in EU or can we keep aggregated billing metrics outside?

alice_acme: they need no plaintext egress of user content. Encrypted backups are ok only if CMK is EU-resident and customer controls keys. Billing metrics (aggregated) can be outside EU but audit logs and any request bodies must remain in EU.

maya_legal: from contract side we can include CMK clause and map SCC Module 2/3 as they need. We'll need to surface subprocessors and an incident notification SLA (48h). I can prep a DPA addendum.

leo_se: tech reality: Redwood supports region pinning + Private deployment. For hosted, we can pin model execution + object store to eu-west, and enable CMK via customer KMS integration. Deletion API exists: `DELETE /v1/tenants/{id}/records?scope=customer_content` which queues scrub jobs that remove KV cache, embeddings shards, and object references; we emit audit events. Typical completion time depends on index size but we can aim for 30 days.

tara_infra: logging nuance: access logs and request payloads are separate. We can route logs to EU-only buckets and set retention to 90 days for audit logs. For deep forensic logs (full request bodies for troubleshooting) we normally keep 180 days; we can shorten for this tenant in the sandbox but need explicit ack on audit tradeoffs.

sam_sales: Acme also wants a runbook showing the DSAR flow they can give to their auditors: API calls, expected SLOs, audit events, and proof that deleted content is unrecoverable. Can we produce that?

jordan_sec: I'll assemble a DSAR runbook + CAIQ extract covering the flagged controls (data residency, key management, deletion verification, incident response). Will include redacted SOC2 and pen test summary.

maya_legal: I'll draft DPA language: "processing shall occur within EU regions; subprocessors listed separately; CMK option preserves customer key ownership; deletion requests honored within 30 days except where retention mandated by law; incident notification within 48 hours." Will add SCC mapping notes.

alice_acme: operational request: during POC we need an isolated sandbox seeded with synthetic-but-production-like data and the ability to trigger deletions and see audit events. Also want to validate that embeddings are scrubbed.

leo_se: propose two-week POC: day0 deploy sandbox in eu-central, day2 ingest sanitized dataset, day5 run deletion scenarios and a validation script that queries indexes and object storage to confirm absence, day10 run incident-notify drill. We'll provide sanitizer script and validation checklist.

deploybot: [deploy] ephemeral sandbox rwd-eu-poc-19 created in eu-central, expires in 14 days.

tara_infra: I'll enable CMK with EU KMS, set logs to EU-only buckets, and set retention toggles as requested. I'll document how to trigger a full scrub and how to verify audit events.

sam_sales: good. Jordan/maya - can you deliver the artifact bundle (CAIQ, DSAR runbook, DPA draft, redacted SOC2/pen test) by EOD tomorrow? Alice, we'll schedule kickoff with your compliance lead.

jordan_sec: yes, CAIQ extract + runbook by 17:00 CET tomorrow.

maya_legal: DPA draft + SCC notes by EOD.

alice_acme: thanks all, we'll review and bring compliance to the kickoff.

sam_sales: closing loop here 97 I'll post calendar invites and attach the artifact checklist. Ping me for blockers. :wave:
